CREATE TABLE pointer (
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  uri text NOT NULL,
  app text NOT NULL,
  source_id text NOT NULL,
  version_seq bigint NOT NULL,
  etag text,
  content_hash text NOT NULL,
  title text,
  owner_id text,
  created_at timestamptz,
  modified_at timestamptz,
  acl_ref text NOT NULL,
  vector_ids text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  last_verified timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, uri),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, app, source_id),
  CONSTRAINT row_small CHECK (pg_column_size(pointer.*) < 4096)
);
ALTER TABLE pointer ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_only ON pointer USING (tenant_id = current_setting('brain.tenant_id'));

ix_ptr.code:
def upsert_pointer(conn, p):
    conn.execute("SELECT set_config('brain.tenant_id', %s, true)", (p.tenant_id,))
    with conn.transaction():
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT version_seq, content_hash FROM pointer"
            " WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s FOR UPDATE", (p.tenant_id, p.uri)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO pointer(tenant_id,uri,app,source_id,version_seq,etag,content_hash,"
                "title,owner_id,created_at,modified_at,acl_ref) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
                (p.tenant_id,p.uri,p.app,p.source_id,p.version_seq,p.etag,p.content_hash,
                 p.title,p.owner_id,p.created_at,p.modified_at,p.acl_ref))
            return "inserted"
        stored_v, stored_h = row
        newer = p.version_seq > stored_v or (p.version_seq == stored_v and p.content_hash != stored_h)
        if not newer:
            if p.version_seq == stored_v:  # same version, same hash: only prove it is still fresh
                conn.execute("UPDATE pointer SET last_verified=now() WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s",
                             (p.tenant_id, p.uri))
                return "verified"
            return "stale"  # older: no-op, counted, never an error
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE pointer SET version_seq=%s, etag=%s, content_hash=%s, title=%s, owner_id=%s,"
            " modified_at=%s, acl_ref=%s, last_verified=now() WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s",
            (p.version_seq,p.etag,p.content_hash,p.title,p.owner_id,p.modified_at,p.acl_ref,
             p.tenant_id,p.uri))
        return "updated"

ix_link.interface: def neighbours(conn, tenant_id: str, node_ids: list[str], edge_types: list[str], allowed_acl: list[str], hops: int = 2, cap: int = 50) -> list[dict]  # [{'node_id', 'edge_type', 'weight', 'source_uri', 'hop'}]
ix_link.code:
def neighbours(conn, tenant_id, node_ids, edge_types, allowed_acl, hops=2, cap=50):
    seen = set(node_ids)
    frontier = list(node_ids)
    out = []
    for hop in range(1, hops + 1):
        nxt = []
        for node in frontier:
            # ACL filter is inside the read: an unreadable edge is never fetched
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT dst, type, weight, source_uri FROM edge"
                " WHERE tenant_id=%s AND src=%s AND type = ANY(%s)"
                " AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > now()) AND acl_ref = ANY(%s)"
                " ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT %s",
                (tenant_id, node, edge_types, allowed_acl, cap)).fetchall()
            for dst, etype, weight, src_uri in rows:
                if dst in seen:
                    continue  # dedupe by node id across hops
                seen.add(dst)
                nxt.append(dst)
                out.append({"node_id": dst, "edge_type": etype, "weight": weight,
                            "source_uri": src_uri, "hop": hop})
        frontier = nxt
    return out

def expire_for_tombstone(conn, tenant_id, uri):
    # a deleted document stops contributing edges at once; the purge removes the rows later
    conn.execute("UPDATE edge SET valid_to = now() WHERE tenant_id=%s AND source_uri=%s"
                 " AND valid_to IS NULL", (tenant_id, uri))

ix_fresh.code:
import time

def observe(conn, tenant_id, uri, observed_version):
    # last_verified comes from the brain's own clock (now()), never from the source
    row = conn.execute("SELECT version_seq FROM pointer WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s"
                       " FOR UPDATE", (tenant_id, uri)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return "confirmed"
    if observed_version != row[0]:
        conn.execute("UPDATE pointer SET version_seq=%s, last_changed=now(), last_verified=now()"
                     " WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s AND version_seq < %s",
                     (observed_version, tenant_id, uri, observed_version))
        queue_rederive(conn, tenant_id, uri, observed_version)
        return "changed"
    conn.execute("UPDATE pointer SET last_verified=now() WHERE tenant_id=%s AND uri=%s",
                 (tenant_id, uri))
    return "confirmed"

def is_stale(last_verified, ceiling_s, now=None):
    now = now or time.time()
    return (now - last_verified.timestamp()) > ceiling_s

def refresh_lag_hist(conn):
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO lag_hist(tenant_id, app, p50_s, p95_s, max_s)"
        " SELECT tenant_id, app,"
        "  percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_verified)),"
        "  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_verified)),"
        "  max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_verified))"
        " FROM pointer WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id, app")

def claim_view(conn, ids, now):
    rows = conn.execute('''SELECT c.claim_id, a.locator, a.author, a.observed_at

          AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR a.valid_to > %s)''', (ids, now)).fetchall()
